customManagers.description: The local pre-commit validator runs the same Renovate version as the engine image. Same depName as CI_RENOVATE_IMAGE, so both move in one MR.

packageRules.description: renovate-runner lives on gitlab.com, not this self-hosted instance; point its version lookup there. Runner-only: the upstream template ref exists solely in this runner's .gitlab-ci.yml, so the rule stays here rather than in the shared preset.

Do not digest-pin the renovate engine image. The upstream runner preset ships a customManager that extracts CI_RENOVATE_IMAGE (ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate:<tag>) with an OPTIONAL currentDigest group; config:best-practices then raises a pinDigest update, but because the line has no digest yet the writer finds nothing to replace (foundValue=undefined) — so the renovate/pin-dependencies branch fails with 'update failure' on every run. pinDigests:false drops that pin (the engine image's only pin-dependencies upgrade), emptying the branch. Tag bumps still flow via the renovate self-update group.

The engine also automerges its minor bumps; the shared preset automerges digest, pin and patch updates estate-wide, and minor bumps elsewhere stay manual. platformAutomerge stays on here although the shared preset turns it off: the engine carries no soak, so GitLab's 'merge when pipeline succeeds', which ignores Renovate's stability status, loses nothing, and the engine bump lands as soon as CI passes instead of on the next run (every 4 hours). Major bumps are excluded: a 43->44 engine upgrade can change config semantics across every repo and is worth reading first.
